items.headline: Kim ne tactical parmanu hathiyar badhane ko kaha
items.detail: Kim Jong Un ne parmanu samagri aur hathiyar suvidhaon ke nirikshan ke dauran kaha — tactical parmanu hathiyaron ko kai kshetron me tainat kiya jaye aur parmanu samagri utpadan badhaya ja raha hai; KCNA ke mutabik unhone North Korea ki parmanu shakti ko 'bilkul atoot' bataya.
items.exam_angle: North Korea parmanu karyakram, Korea praaydweep suraksha — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cairo me tanker aag, 31 log mare
items.detail: Cairo ke paas Giza ki Ring Road par petroleum tanker palatne se lagi aag me kam se kam 31 log mare aur 21 ghayal hue; aag me 27 gaadiyan jal gayi, jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: North Korea ne Swiss daftar band karwaya
items.detail: North Korea ne Pyongyang me Switzerland ka naya rajnaitik daftar band karne ko kaha aur uske pramukh ko 48 ghante me desh chhodne ka aadesh diya — Switzerland ne ek bachchon ke shivir par pratibandh lagaye the.
items.exam_angle: North Korea-Switzerland sambandh, pratibandh kootneeti — UPSC IR

items.headline: Pakistani astronaut pehli baar Tiangong station par
items.detail: Pakistan ke Muhammad Zeeshan Ali Shenzhou-24 se China ke Tiangong station par pahunchne wale pehle videshi astronaut bane; Tang Hongbo aur Wu Yi ke saath woh lagbhag ek hafta prayog karenge.
items.exam_angle: China-Pakistan antariksh sahyog, Tiangong station — UPSC S&T/IR
items.image_credit: China News Service, CC BY 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Murmansk governor bhrashtachar me hirasat me
items.detail: Russia ke Murmansk kshetra ke governor Andrei Chibis ko bade bhrashtachar jaanch me Moscow court ne do mahine ki hirasat me bheja; woh Ukraine yuddh shuru hone ke baad giraftar hone wale pehle sewarat governor hain.
items.exam_angle: Russia Arctic, Northern Sea Route, Murmansk — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Presidential Executive Office of Russia, CC BY 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Ramaphosa ko Farmgate jaanch se rahat
items.detail: South Africa ki Western Cape High Court ne 2022 ki Section 89 panel report ko 'gair-kanuni' batakar radd kar diya; Phala Phala farm chori par Rashtrapati Cyril Ramaphosa ke khilaf mahabhiyog jaanch khatm ho gayi.
items.exam_angle: South Africa, Phala Phala, mahabhiyog — UPSC IR/Polity

items.headline: Bangladesh: garment mazdoori 36% badhi
items.detail: Bangladesh ne garment mazdooron ki nyuntam mazdoori 36% badhakar 17,000 taka kar di; hafton ke virodh ke baad wage board ne 4-2 vote se faisla kiya, nayi dar 1 December se lagu hogi.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh RMG, shram, niryaat — UPSC Economy/IR

items.headline: Russia se riot gas rokne ki maang
items.detail: 34 deshon aur EU ne Russia se Ukraine yuddh me riot-control gas ka istemal turant rokne ko kaha; OPCW ki lab ne khaai me mile namoonon me CS gas ki pushti ki, Ukraine ne 2022 se 14,000 se zyada aise mamle darj kiye hain.
items.exam_angle: OPCW, Chemical Weapons Convention, CS gas — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Ukraine ko $622m ke F-16 upkaran
items.detail: America ne Ukraine ke F-16 ladaku vimanon ke liye $622 million ke rakh-rakhav upkaranon ki bikri ko manzoori di; kharcha Belgium, Denmark, Netherlands aur Norway uthayenge, America ka koi paisa nahi lagega.
items.exam_angle: F-16, JUMPSTART, NATO sahyog — UPSC IR/Defence
items.image_credit: Staff Sgt. Cherie A. Thurlby, US Air Force, Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Kyiv mall par ballistic missile hamla
items.detail: Russia ne der raat Kyiv par ballistic missile hamla kiya; Desnianskyi jile me ek shopping mall aur do aur imaratein nishana bani, kam se kam 4 log ghayal hue, jinme se 2 ki haalat gambhir hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, ballistic missile — UPSC IR

items.headline: Lebanon ka doosra airport December me
items.detail: Lebanon ka doosra antarrashtriya airport — uttar me Qlayaat (Rene Mouawad) — 14 December se vyavsayik udanein shuru karega; Hezbollah ke kamzor prabhav ke baad khula ye airport pehle Turkey, Egypt aur Jordan ki udanein dega.
items.exam_angle: Lebanon, Hezbollah, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Riyadh tower par Houthi drone hamla
items.detail: Houthi drone ne Riyadh ke financial district ki ek tower par hamla kiya; 11 log ghayal hue, jinme 2 Bharatiya bhi hain; Bharat ne hamle ki kadi ninda ki.
items.exam_angle: Houthi, Saudi Arabia, West Asia — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ka birthright citizenship order roka
items.detail: America ke doosre judge ne bhi Trump ke birthright citizenship seemit karne wale aadesh par rok lagayi; ab prashasan ko dono faislon ko palatna hoga.
items.exam_angle: US 14th Amendment, birthright citizenship — UPSC Polity/IR

items.headline: Ukraine ne Savasleyka hawai-adda par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ne Russia ke Savasleyka hawai-adde par hamla kiya, jahan Kinzhal missile le jaane wale MiG-31K viman tainat hain; hamle me 3 MiG-31 aur 2 Su-34 viman kshatigrast hue.
